Heavy-Duty Power with Premium Comfort.

Built for Big Jobs, Designed for Operator Ease.

The 2024 KIOTI RX7320PCB is a full-size utility tractor designed for high-demand tasks on the farm or job site. With 73 HP under the hood, a power shuttle transmission, and a fully enclosed cab with heat and A/C, this model offers the best of both strength and comfort. From hay handling to land clearing, the RX7320PCB delivers durability, precision, and smooth operation—ideal for year-round use in demanding conditions.

Features may include:

73 HP Turbo Diesel Performance
The KIOTI 4-cylinder engine delivers consistent torque and fuel efficiency under load.

Power Shuttle Transmission
24F/24R power shuttle provides clutchless direction changes for smoother loader work and tight maneuvering.

Premium Cab with Climate Control
Stay comfortable year-round with a factory-installed cab featuring heat, air conditioning, suspension seat, and ergonomic layout.

Heavy-Lift 3-Point Hitch
Category II hitch with 4,450 lbs lift capacity to handle serious implements and attachments.

Independent PTO
540/540E RPM PTO with electronic engagement supports balers, cutters, tillers, and more.

Advanced Hydraulics
Hydraulic flow of 16.5 GPM and dual remotes make it easy to operate large implements and attachments.

4WD & Power Steering
Full-time 4WD and hydrostatic power steering ensure optimal traction and smooth handling in all conditions.
